scripts.compose:check: if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'docker not installed — skipping compose check'; else env VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY=dummy VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID=dummy VITE_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI=dummy VITE_OIDC_SCOPE=dummy VITE_GRAPHQL_API_URL=dummy docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml config -q && env VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY=dummy VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID=dummy VITE_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI=dummy VITE_OIDC_SCOPE=dummy VITE_GRAPHQL_API_URL=dummy docker compose -f docker-compose.yml config -q; fi && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').split('\n').filter(l=>/^ {6}(VITE_|PORT)/.test(l)).join('\n');if(p('docker-compose.yml')!==p('docker-compose.prod.yml')){console.error('docker-compose.yml and docker-compose.prod.yml disagree on the public variable list');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.docker:push: if [ -z "$IMAGE_REGISTRY" ]; then echo 'set IMAGE_REGISTRY (e.g. ghcr.io/acme/) before pushing' >&2; exit 1; fi; docker push "${IMAGE_REGISTRY}litefront:${IMAGE_TAG:-latest}"
scripts.gen: bash -c 'if [ -z "${VITE_GRAPHQL_API_URL:-}" ] && [ -f .env ]; then VITE_GRAPHQL_API_URL=$(sed -n "s/^VITE_GRAPHQL_API_URL=//p" .env | tail -1); fi; if [ -z "${VITE_GRAPHQL_API_URL:-}" ]; then echo "VITE_GRAPHQL_API_URL is not set — export it, or copy .env.example to .env" >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! curl -sf -m 5 -o /dev/null -X POST "$VITE_GRAPHQL_API_URL" -H "content-type: application/json" -d "{\"query\":\"{__typename}\"}"; then echo "the backend is not answering at VITE_GRAPHQL_API_URL=$VITE_GRAPHQL_API_URL — start it: cd backend && task start:dev" >&2; exit 1; fi; graphql-codegen --require dotenv/config --config codegen.yml'
scripts.test:all: npm run test:prod && npm run test:e2e:prod
scripts.check: npm run compose:check && npx run-p lint:style ts:check lint knip lint:fsd trio
scripts.secrets: bash -c 'if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then gitleaks git --staged -v --no-banner .; else echo "⚠️  gitleaks not installed; skipping secrets scan."; fi'
scripts.secrets:history: bash -c 'if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then gitleaks git . -v --no-banner; else echo "⚠️  gitleaks not installed; skipping secrets scan."; fi'
scripts.verify:commit: npm run check && npm run secrets
scripts.verify:push: npm run verify:commit && npm run secrets:history && npm run test:cov && npm run test:e2e:prod && npm run storybook:build && npm run stories:check && npx rimraf storybook-build
scripts.update: npx ncu -u && npx rimraf node_modules package-lock.json && npm i
scripts.postupdate: npm run lint:fix && npm run check
